rules: enemybase numeric fields are loaded with atoi in the fixed descendant; LVUPPOINT text such as 5.00 therefore becomes integer 5
PETRANK is calculated from the unmodified template sum BASEVITAL+BASESTR+BASETGH+BASEDEX
each growth-base component then receives an explicit -2..+2 birth offset
the individualized four bytes are packed into CHAR_ALLOCPOINT before spawn-stat allocation
ten independent 0..3 allocation outcomes add exactly ten points across the four current-stat bases
current internal VITAL/STR/TOUGH/DEX = (((level-1)*LVUPPOINT)+INITNUM) * (individualized base + spawn allocation count)
CHAR_complianceParameter then derives client-facing max HP / attack / defence / quick and other work values

generation_rules: NPCCREATE floor/born area selects the runtime spawn floor/X/Y; the chosen X/Y are runtime values rather than template IDs
NPCTEMPLATE IMAGENUMBER becomes runtime base image unless NPCCREATE BASEIMAGENUMBER overrides it
NPCTEMPLATE CHARNAME becomes runtime CHAR_NAME unless NPCCREATE NAME overrides it
NPC generation allocates a CHAR instance first and then allocates an OBJECT entry with initObjectOne; that allocated object index becomes CHAR_WORKOBJINDEX
the C world-object serializer emits the allocated object index in base-62 and reads X/Y from OBJECT state plus direction/image/name/default CHAR presentation state

fields not explicitly assigned by NPC generation, including level/title/walkable/height presentation values, come from the default CHAR/type/runtime state rather than directly from the NPC template row

fields.object_type: runtime CHAR_WHICHTYPE / default-runtime character type; exact numeric early mapping remains version-bound
fields.x: runtime OBJECT X selected at spawn
fields.y: runtime OBJECT Y selected at spawn
fields.base_graphic_id: NPCTEMPLATE IMAGENUMBER with NPCCREATE BASEIMAGENUMBER override
fields.name_color: runtime/default presentation state; later descendants may derive display color from additional systems
fields.name: NPCTEMPLATE CHARNAME with NPCCREATE NAME override
